translations.web: I will turn you around, and will lead you on, and will cause you to come up from the uttermost parts of the north; and I will bring you onto the mountains of Israel.
translations.bsb: I will turn you around, drive you along, bring you up from the far north, and send you against the mountains of Israel.
translations.kjv: And I will turn thee back, and leave but the sixth part of thee, and will cause thee to come up from the north parts, and will bring thee upon the mountains of Israel:
